patches.title: Open Destination Before Placement
patches.principle: Before placing an object into a container, ensure the container is open.
patches.when_to_apply: When about to place an object into a closed container.

patches.title: Hold Object Through Transformation
patches.principle: Once you pick up the target object, do not drop it until after the required transformation and final placement.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning, cooling, or heating.

patches.title: Search Containers Before Surfaces
patches.principle: First open all closed containers systematically, then check open surfaces (countertops, tables, etc.) for the target.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible and the task requires locating it.
